title: Denying, and Asking
label: ch:ar-denying-and-asking
canDo: I can deny a nominal sentence with ليس, a past-tense verb with ما and a present-tense verb with لا, refuse two things at once with لا … ولا, and turn any of them into a yes-or-no question with هل.

payoff.summary: Three negators sorted by the kind of sentence each one owns, then every one of them asked back with هل -- so نعم and لا, taught in chapter 5 as answers, finally have a question to answer.
